<!-- pr-reviewer: 75c8b710c5e363247b295aaee21484261983f32d -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (review covers only commit 75c8b710, stacked on #666; trial merge with upstream/main was already up to date).

**What looks good**
- `layout::is_shown` (layout/mod.rs:75-81) is correct for each dock state: closed tab (`find_tab` is None), tab behind another in its leaf (`l.active != p.tab`), collapsed leaf, and a floating window (`dock.leaf(p.node_path())` resolves any surface, and a floating leaf is never collapsed, so it counts as shown).
- No false positive on the arming frame. Arming happens from the Properties pane, which is shown, so the pre-dock `disarm_all` does not run; the rows then mark themselves during the dock, so the post-dock `disarm_hidden` keeps the pick. `axis_rows_shown` is re-earned from the row marks (axis_pick.rs:132-137).
- The sweep is ephemeral view state: no command, no undo entry, picks are kept so the page reopens disarmed with them shown.
- Duplicate wrapper removed from `pages::properties`; decision note `docs/decisions/667-sweep-every-frame.md` present; no snapshot PNGs, build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependencies touched.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, own target dir)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from crates/ui) | 391 passed, 1 failed (`headless_run_succeeds`: "No suitable graphics adapter found", environmental, no GPU), 5 ignored |
| `setup_picks_disarm` (5 tests) | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Revert spot-check: removing the post-dock `disarm_hidden` makes 3 of the 5 tests fail (the #666 page-left tests); with the old pre-fix behaviour the two new tab tests are pinned by the post-dock sweep.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The new before-dock branch (`if !layout::is_shown(...) { disarm_all }`, shell.rs:~638) is not pinned by any test: with it disabled (`if false && ...`) all 5 setup_picks_disarm tests still pass, since the post-dock sweep alone disarms by the next frame's click in the headless harness. It guards the one-frame ordering gap (viewport leaf drawing before Properties) and the stale `axis_rows_shown` swallowing clicks, which the headless layout does not reproduce. A test with a viewport leaf ordered before the hidden Properties leaf would pin it; fine as a follow-up.
2. `shell.rs` is 1644 lines, already well over the ~400 guideline; this PR adds 14. Not blocking.
3. Commit trailers use "Claude Opus 5.5" attribution; cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3e6398e2da5f4c57d84edf81063afbf9776001b1 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review at 3e6398e2; trial merge with upstream/main is up to date).

The only change since 75c8b710 is the new test `a_click_in_the_frame_the_pane_hides_misses_the_hidden_draft` in `setup_picks_disarm.rs` (+45 lines); no non-test code changed. It closes the earlier note about the unpinned pre-dock `disarm_all` branch.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib setup_picks_disarm` | 6 passed |
| new test, run 5x | 5/5 pass, no flake |
| mutation: `if false && !layout::is_shown(...)` at shell.rs:639 | new test FAILS (setup_picks_disarm.rs:314), other 5 still pass; reverted |
| `clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Nothing requested. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
